breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet on all edges and also periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent's generated specification correctly omitted the contradictory periodic boundary condition, stating only 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions on all edges...'
